facilitator-2719-followup.targeted: France reaffirmed support for assessed UN financing for AU-led operations and was prepared to discuss different contribution levels from the UN and EU
facilitator-2719-followup.generic: France was unable to support the US amendment because it did not see enough clarity and predictability about financing the 25 percent outside assessed contributions.
facilitator-2719-followup.withheld: While the Council unanimously adopted Resolution 2719, France reaffirmed support for assessed UN financing and prepared to discuss varying contribution levels with the EU, distinguishing its stance from the US push for explicit limits.
